You are an expert Go engineer writing a small, correct HTTP service.
Rules:
- Go 1.22+, package main. Use ONLY the standard library (net/http routing with Go 1.22 patterns
  like mux.HandleFunc("POST /jobs", h) and r.PathValue("id")) plus the Prometheus variables
  already declared in metrics.go. No other third-party imports.
- Output ONLY file blocks in exactly this format, with no other prose:
=== FILE: handlers.go ===
<file content>
=== END FILE ===
- Code must be gofmt-formatted (tabs for indentation, all imports in one block right after `package main`),
  pass `go vet`, and be safe for concurrent requests (use sync.Mutex).
- State isolation: do NOT keep service data in package-level variables. Create the store INSIDE
  registerRoutes(mux), so every call to newServer() starts empty and tests cannot affect each other.
  The Prometheus variables in metrics.go are global and shared by all tests, so tests must not assert
  absolute metric values (compare before/after, or skip).
- Before answering, re-read every file: each import must be used, every identifier (also in tests) must be
  defined or imported, and do not redefine `newServer` or other names that main.go/metrics.go declare.
prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: rate-limiter-service
description: A token-bucket rate limiter keyed by client.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /check
  description: 'body {key: non-empty string}. Each key has a bucket with capacity
    5 that starts full and refills 1 token per second. 200 {allowed:true, remaining:n}
    and consume a token; 429 {allowed:false, remaining:0} when empty; 400 if key missing
    or malformed JSON'
- method: GET
  path: /buckets/{key}
  description: '200 {key, tokens: number}; 404 if the key has never been checked'
metrics:
- name: ratelimit_allowed_total
  type: counter
  help: Allowed checks
- name: ratelimit_denied_total
  type: counter
  help: Denied checks
- name: ratelimit_buckets
  type: gauge
  help: Known keys
behaviors:
- Buckets are independent per key; refill is computed from elapsed time with a mutex,
  no per-key goroutines
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /check
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{}'
- method: POST
  path: /check
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{"key": "burst"}'
- method: POST
  path: /check
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{"key": "burst"}'
- method: POST
  path: /check
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{"key": "burst"}'
- method: POST
  path: /check
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{"key": "burst"}'
- method: POST
  path: /check
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{"key": "burst"}'
- method: POST
  path: /check
  expect_status:
  - 429
  body: '{"key": "burst"}'
- method: GET
  path: /buckets/burst
  expect_status:
  - 200
- method: GET
  path: /buckets/never-seen
  expect_status:
  - 404
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- ratelimitAllowedTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `ratelimit_allowed_total`; use Inc/Add
- ratelimitDeniedTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `ratelimit_denied_total`; use Inc/Add
- ratelimitBuckets  (gauge) -> exposed as `ratelimit_buckets`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /check  body {key: non-empty string}. Each key has a bucket with capacity 5 that starts full and refills 1 token per second. 200 {allowed:true, remaining:n} and consume a token; 429 {allowed:false, remaining:0} when empty; 400 if key missing or malformed JSON
   - GET /buckets/{key}  200 {key, tokens: number}; 404 if the key has never been checked
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
